acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Elementals family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Wisp, T1, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Drift-Trace Initiate (Initiate) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two normal construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Palm-sized asymmetric teardrop or flame-like entity with one visible seed, a pointed crest, a continuous tapering tail, no face, no limbs, and no projectile trail.
Signature mechanic: Trace Drift: the Wisp curls its lower tail toward a small gathering eddy, glides to that point as one continuous creature, and briefly dims on arrival.
battlefieldDuty: Probe movement with one small airborne entity that commits to a visibly prepared destination.
constructionDimensions: Unaffiliated forms use desaturated silver-grey, softly translucent neutral spell-matter folded inward around a matte charcoal binding seed or core.
Motion remains smooth, quiet, and self-contained, leaving only a brief colorless distortion with no elemental particles, status cue, or environmental residue.
counterplay: Leave the gathering eddy, follow behind the completed drift, and strike the dimmed binding seed before the body recovers. Affinity signal: The charcoal seed, channel gap, core ring, mantle shutter, or sovereign facet dulls after the form commits to its family mechanic.
forbiddenTreatments: Featureless orb without the form's declared silhouette
identityInvariants: Every form is organized around one readable binding seed or core, with no flesh, worn armor, ordinary clothing, handheld weapon, or fixed face.
The T1 Wisp is a small asymmetric teardrop or flame-like shape without limbs; T2–T5 develop a legless hovering upper body with exactly two coherent arm channels and a tapering lower body.
Affinity substance forms the complete load-bearing body, limbs, mantle, and directional wake rather than appearing as a colored exterior aura or decorative overlay.
Form coherence, core structure, and spatial control progress from one wandering Wisp to a four-facet Sovereign while the active telegraph and exposed counterplay remain readable.
telegraph: The asymmetric teardrop leans, its pointed crest bends, and its continuous lower tail curls toward the forming eddy.
